allowedMismatches.reason: The vendored IPMarketFactory declares VERSION() pure; deployed PendleMarketFactoryV7Upg implements it view. Read-only relaxation, and Moss never calls VERSION() (the verifier uses isValidMarket/factory/readTokens/expiry/token support/decimals).

selectorProxies.note: Router and RouterStatic are selector proxies with a zero ERC-1967 slot. The online ABI suite pins the facets reached by every vendored function selector, fetches those facet ABIs from Monadscan, and compares selector semantics plus the available facet union. The point-lookup registries cannot enumerate facets that no vendored selector reaches.
